decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All materials used in the construction of the alterations shall be consistent with the details described in the Bedford Park Society Manual.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the information shown on the submitted plans, should any flue or soil vent pipe become visible externally, further details are to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The application for internal alterations to form a ground floor toilet, as shown on drawing numbers, 695/05 and 695/06, received 15 August 2006, is recommended for approval as it would not harm the architectural or historic character or the setting of the listed building and would maintain the amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Internal alterations to form ground floor W.C. (Listed Building works)
